answer: Reaching eligibility takes 37 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The umber register is checked at draw time, vault lists the eligible set, and sparrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 37 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Collateral of 21 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
